title: A purchase of 100 paid 150: the supplier is left holding the extra 50 in both systems; the reference system offers a settle button with two options, this application has no button and the payment is edited

overpaid_purchase.note: A payment of 150 on a purchase of 100 accepted: journal 000168 debits the supplier 150 and credits the treasury 150; the purchase is shown paid in excess with a banner

settle_options.note: The Settle button of an overpaid purchase: option 2 turns the excess into supplier credit (the payment cut to 50 and a new payment of 100 on the invoice), option 1 removes the excess (the payment cut to 100 and 50 back in the treasury)

cases.reason: The owner decided (E29) that a payment above what a purchase needs leaves the surplus as supplier credit and that there is no settle button: whoever wants the money back edits the payment, which reverses its journal and posts it again.

options: turn the excess into supplier credit
